verdict.rationale: Bolt.new is an AI app-building SaaS, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a setting or policy that keeps user data out of AI model training. Items on private site visibility, Supabase data control, and collaborator roles are adjacent controls and earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
